up: Retrieve the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity type, standard value, standard units, and standard relation for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614076. Filter the results to include only exact activity measurements where the standard relation is '=' and the standard value is not null. Return one row per activity measurement. Do not apply any additional filters on organism, target type, or confidence scores.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614076' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
